01 // THE MANIFESTO

An Epoch of Awakening at IIT Bombay

Founded in 1998, Techfest has grown from an ambitious student initiative into Asia’s largest annual gathering of science, engineering, and digital culture.

For our landmark 30th Edition, An Aetherial Renaissance bridges Renaissance philosophy—Leonardo da Vinci’s harmony of art and mechanics—with the frontier of modern deep-tech: autonomous humanoids, prompt engineering, space exploration, and quantum architectures.

06 // PRACTICAL GUIDE

Frequently Asked Questions & Logistics

Everything you need to know about reaching the Powai campus, staying, and participating.

Techfest 2026 runs from 16th to 18th December 2026 at the Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (IIT Bombay), Powai, Mumbai - 400076. Official campus check-ins for registered outstation participants open on 15th December at 06:00 AM.
Yes, on-campus student hostel accommodation is available from 15th December (6 AM) through 19th December (10 AM). Registered competition finalists and workshop participants receive priority booking via the accommodation portal upon generating their Fest Pass.
Entry to the Techfest Exhibition, Keynote Lectures, and Technoholix night shows is 100% free for verified students and attendees who register with a valid college ID and generate their digital Fest Pass.
In partnership with the Motwani Jadeja Foundation, Techfest is the Official Innovation Partner for the India Pavilion at CES 2027 in Las Vegas. Top 10 shortlisted student teams across the InnovateX and Ideate challenges will be awarded fully funded travel to showcase their working prototypes on the international CES stage.
